name: event-security
description: Guards and door staff for events and places.

headcount.description: How many people the seller provides.

howDealsGo: The buyer pays into escrow at booking and releases after the shift. Done is every guard there for the whole shift. A timer to the seller, set past the event, pays for a shift worked if the buyer goes quiet, and a big event may name an arbiter both trust. Before paying, ask whether the guards hold the licence the place requires.
